stage: pre-selection (fixed before any selection-block method F1 was observed)

selection_amendment.reason: the originally reserved block 206-215 was found partially contaminated: 212-215 already carry produced output from out/paper_full_pipeline_run/synthetic/
selection_amendment.decision: selection = 206-211 (the fresh part of the originally reserved block) + 112-115 (next fresh seeds)
selection_amendment.owner_decision: protocol owner approved option A on 2026-09-17

cost_configuration.amount_component: removed from the PAIRWISE cost only; the amount-derived transport marginals are preserved unchanged
cost_configuration.back_door_closed: cost weights, epsilon, lambda and the normalisation are NOT re-tuned in R7, not even if the expanded generator lowers performance; if the cost proves unsuitable that is a result

shared_cost_requirement.rule: every method in a cell consumes the SAME C and the SAME P
shared_cost_requirement.recorded: cost_matrix_sha256 per cell, asserted equal across methods

generator.degree_distribution: frozen pooled empirical fan-out (split) and fan-in (merge)
preserved_mechanisms: amount allocation (generalised to equal shares amount/d)

degree_calibration.source: frozen v4 and v5 audit windows (paper section 4.6)

sampling_spec.pooling: v4/v5 unique protocol-anchored units, deduped on the canonical anchor identity; v5 contributes more units and therefore carries more weight in the pooled distribution, as required

arms.UOT_KR: selected rule applied to the direct forensic kernel logK = -C/eps
arms.RAW_UOT_PLAN: same rule applied to the raw UOT plan P
arms.CONDITIONAL_UOT: same rule on the dual-cancelling conditional scores
arms.SUPPORT_PLUS_K: same rule on logK with a HARD support filter (P > 1e-9 at the candidate-set level)
arms.HUNGARIAN_1TO1: cost-optimal one-to-one assignment baseline: rectangular linear sum assignment on the same C, label-free
arms.THRESHOLD_MM: edge iff C_ij <= cutoff; cutoff fixed on the selection block
arms.DUAL_SOFTMAX: LoFTR-style dual softmax on logK with bidirectional (mutual nearest neighbour) acceptance and a confidence gate

diagnostics_not_baselines.ORACLE_1TO1_CEILING: label-informed maximum-cardinality matching on the ground-truth positive graph; not deployable, not in H1/H2, not in Holm, never used to build a UOT_KR prediction

C1_hungarian_is_not_an_f1_upper_bound.as_proposed: HUNGARIAN_1TO1 described as the F1 upper bound for one-to-one methods
C1_hungarian_is_not_an_f1_upper_bound.operational: HUNGARIAN_1TO1 is the cost-optimal one-to-one ASSIGNMENT BASELINE at the same forensic cost C. It is not, and must never be written as, an F1 upper bound or a performance upper bound.
C1_hungarian_is_not_an_f1_upper_bound.added: ORACLE_1TO1_CEILING, a pre-registered label-informed diagnostic that does answer what the one-to-one output space can reach: with T true edges and maximum non-conflicting true edges M, precision=1, recall=M/T, F1=2M/(T+M).

interpretation_rule.UOT_KR > ORACLE_CEILING: strong output-space evidence: one-to-one output semantics impose a measurable ceiling under this synthetic truth topology
interpretation_rule.UOT_KR > HUNGARIAN only: only licenses 'this many-to-many decoding outperformed the cost-optimal one-to-one assignment baseline at equal cost'

C2_gate_c_is_not_an_execution_validity_g.as_proposed: per-bridge mean effect >= -0.005 listed as an EXECUTION VALIDITY gate
C2_gate_c_is_not_an_execution_validity_g.problem: a result-dependent threshold must never be able to declare a valid confirmatory execution void
C2_gate_c_is_not_an_execution_validity_g.if_C_fails: the experiment remains a VALID confirmatory result, but no cross-bridge-consistent overall advantage may be claimed
C2_gate_c_is_not_an_execution_validity_g.if_D_or_E_fails: TECHNICALLY_INVALID_CONFIRMATORY_EXECUTION; all results, reasons and logs are preserved
C2_gate_c_is_not_an_execution_validity_g.never: 401-410 must never be re-run, for any reason

C3_holm_and_ci_fully_specified.as_proposed: '95% CI + Holm' with no estimand and no adjustment target

primary_estimand.cell: for each (bridge, seed): macro edge F1 = equal-weight mean over the 24 template families of the family-mean edge F1
primary_estimand.pseudoreplication: the several hundred template instances are NEVER treated as independent samples
primary_estimand.overall_effect: mean the 10 seed-level paired deltas within each bridge, then equal-weight mean the 3 bridge means

primary_ci.within_bridge: resample the 10 seed-level paired cells with replacement
primary_ci.paired: both methods of a pair are resampled together
primary_ci.across_bridges: equal-weight macro-average of the 3 bridge means
primary_ci.forbidden: bootstrapping the hundreds of template instances independently

primary_p_value.statistic: equal-weight mean of the 3 bridge means of the 30 paired bridge-seed deltas
primary_p_value.resolution_note: 1.9e-9 is the theoretical order of a FULL exact enumeration of 2^30 sign patterns; this protocol does NOT enumerate them and therefore never reports a p-value below the Monte-Carlo resolution
primary_p_value.multiplicity: Holm step-down over the TWO one-sided primary p-values (H1, H2), FWER alpha = 0.05

secondary.reported: effect, 95% bootstrap CI, unadjusted secondary p
secondary.explicitly: secondary confirmatory hypothesis; NOT in the H1/H2 Holm family

gates.A: H1: effect > 0 AND bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 AND Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05
gates.C: cross-bridge consistency / CLAIM gate: the per-bridge mean H1 and H2 effects must all be >= -0.005. FAIL does NOT invalidate the run; it forbids claiming a cross-bridge-consistent advantage.
gates.D: technical completeness: all expected confirmatory units present, no missing cells, no duplicates, no forbidden seeds, all solver cells converged, final marginal/KKT error < 1e-07, no silent NaN/Inf, all edge sets valid, all cost hashes consistent, support hard filter valid
gates.E: independent metric verification: a frozen validator recomputes precision, recall, macro edge F1, strict exact recovery, edge count and mechanism metrics from the frozen raw prediction/truth files; |diff| <= 1e-9

classification_rules.VALID_NEGATIVE_CONFIRMATORY_RESULT: D/E PASS but A or B FAIL
classification_rules.forbidden_rename: an unfavourable A/B/C scientific result must never be relabelled as an execution failure

reporting_requirements.expected_values: no expected numeric result (for example 'expected to be significantly higher than 0.3104') may survive into the final report; only actual measured results are reported
